tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models available in the multimodal MCP registry. Optional filters: capability, provider, include_paid.

capability.description: Filter to models supporting this capability.

provider.description: Filter to models from this provider.

tools.name: generate_text
tools.description: Generate text from a Gemini model. Useful for cheap structured output or a second-opinion call. Defaults to a cheap text-capable model.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to a cheap text-capable model.

backend.description: Google backend: 'gemini' (AI Studio, GEMINI_API_KEY) or 'vertex' (Vertex AI, GCP_PROJECT_ID + ADC). Defaults to MULTIMODAL_GOOGLE_BACKEND or 'gemini'.

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: Transcribe or analyze a local audio file (mp3, ogg, wav, flac, aiff, aac, m4a) via Gemini. Files <=18 MB are sent inline; larger files are uploaded via the Gemini Files API and polled until ACTIVE before generation. Default prompt produces a timestamped transcript + summary.

audio.description: Absolute path to a local audio file. Supported: mp3, ogg, wav, flac, aiff, aac, m4a.

prompt.description: Instruction for the model. Defaults to a verbatim transcription + summary prompt.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to a cheap audio-capable model.

backend.description: Google backend: 'gemini' (AI Studio, GEMINI_API_KEY) or 'vertex' (Vertex AI, GCP_PROJECT_ID + ADC). Defaults to MULTIMODAL_GOOGLE_BACKEND or 'gemini'.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.description: Describe or analyze a local image file (jpg, png, webp, gif, heic, heif) via Gemini. Files <=18 MB are sent inline; larger files are uploaded through the Gemini Files API and polled until ACTIVE before generation. Default prompt produces a thorough description; override prompt for OCR, design critique, screenshot debugging, etc.

image.description: Absolute path to a local image file. Supported: jpg, png, webp, gif, heic, heif.

prompt.description: Instruction for the model. Defaults to a thorough-description prompt.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to a cheap image-capable model.

backend.description: Google backend: 'gemini' (AI Studio, GEMINI_API_KEY) or 'vertex' (Vertex AI, GCP_PROJECT_ID + ADC). Defaults to MULTIMODAL_GOOGLE_BACKEND or 'gemini'.

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Describe or analyze a local video file (mp4, mov, webm, mpeg, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp) via Gemini. Files <=18 MB are sent inline; larger files are uploaded via the Gemini Files API and polled until ACTIVE (timeout 15 min — videos transcode/index slowly). Default prompt produces a scene-by-scene description with timestamps + summary.

video.description: Absolute path to a local video file. Supported: mp4, mov, webm, mpeg, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp.

prompt.description: Instruction for the model. Defaults to a scene-by-scene description + summary prompt.

model.description: Model id. Defaults to a cheap video-capable model.

backend.description: Google backend: 'gemini' (AI Studio, GEMINI_API_KEY) or 'vertex' (Vertex AI, GCP_PROJECT_ID + ADC). Defaults to MULTIMODAL_GOOGLE_BACKEND or 'gemini'.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit images via Gemini multimodal output (Nano Banana family). Text-to-image by default; pass input_images for image-to-image editing, reference, or composition. Optionally set aspect_ratio and image_size (best on the Pro image models). Saves PNG/JPEG/WebP to disk and returns the paths. Default model is the cheap gemini-2.5-flash-image; paid models (nano-banana-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-image-preview) require confirm_paid: true.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate, or the edit to apply when input_images are given. Be specific about subject, composition, style, lighting.

input_images.description: Local image paths (jpg, png, webp, gif, heic, heif) used as references for image-to-image editing or composition. When set, the prompt edits/combines these.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Best supported on the Pro image models.

image_size.description: Output resolution. Supported on the Pro image models (e.g. gemini-3-pro-image-preview).

model.description: Model id. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash-image. Paid options: nano-banana-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-image-preview.

output_dir.description: Directory to save generated images. Defaults to ~/.multimodal-mcp/images (override the root with MULTIMODAL_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR). Relative paths resolve against the server's working directory; prefer an absolute path.

confirm_paid.description: Required (true) when invoking a model in the 'paid' cost tier. Refuses paid calls otherwise.

backend.description: Google backend: 'gemini' (AI Studio, GEMINI_API_KEY) or 'vertex' (Vertex AI, GCP_PROJECT_ID + ADC). Defaults to MULTIMODAL_GOOGLE_BACKEND or 'gemini'.

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.description: Summarize this machine's locally-logged multimodal-mcp usage: call counts, token totals, and estimated cost (at paid-tier rates), grouped by model, tool, and backend. Reads ~/.multimodal-mcp/usage.jsonl. Costs are approximate and omitted for models with no known price.

since.description: Only include calls at or after this ISO date/datetime (e.g. 2026-06-01).

until.description: Only include calls at or before this ISO date/datetime.
